prompt650_rationale: A new executable task kind (e.g. add_file/modify_file) must be wired into the Codex-facing prompt and effect-spec generation (task_planner.build_task_prompt / build_task_effect_spec) and task_spec validation. That places a NEW code path on the safety-critical live execution surface. Per the project's own precedent, add_function was only accepted after live effect-verified runtime acceptance (prompt638d/639/644a). Accepting a new kind responsibly therefore requires a live, bounded /tmp runtime acceptance under the strict effect gate — which is OUTSIDE this loop's offline, no-uncontrolled-daemon, no-Codex scope. The meta prompt explicitly permits marking this target blocked if too risky/broad.
prompt650_why_not_blocking_goal: Every project-orchestration layer above task_spec (intent model, plan model, plan generation, queue population, completion gate, loop controller) is kind-agnostic. add_function already exercises the entire offline project-autonomy chain end to end. Task-kind breadth widens WHAT can be changed but is not required to PROVE project-level autonomous orchestration offline.
prompt650_recommended_followup: A dedicated prompt that implements add_file (strict path validation, no traversal/secrets/shell/deletion) AND runs a bounded live /tmp effect-verified acceptance, mirroring prompt638d/639/644a, before tagging.
